summary: Apply GSTC criteria and visitor-management methods to eco-tourism operations. Build site assessments and improvement plans; explore the course.
lede: Eco-tourism training covers responsible nature-based visitor experiences that support conservation and community benefits. For tour guides, operators, lodge supervisors and destination practitioners, it develops practical ways to manage visitor activity and site pressures. Participants learn to map visitor journeys, assess impacts using Limits of Acceptable Change indicators, apply visitor-management guidance and document local purchasing and improvement actions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people responsible for the on-the-ground choices that shape nature-based visitor experiences, site protection and local economic participation.
modules: Limits of Acceptable Change in Visitor Operations
GSTC Industry Criteria and Local Supply
prerequisites: Working familiarity with tourism operations, visitor services or destination activities is recommended. No coding or programming is required.
